answer: Anyone can spin up addresses, but a trust edge only counts while fresh work renews it, so a thread left hanging goes slack and the vertex it pointed at bleeds weight. Each submission carries a fresh nonce, so a copied attestation is dead on arrival. The dashboard paints a violet warning after two unrenewed epochs, and that is the whole alarm system. Blunt version, a thousand silent clones sit at zero and cannot buy their way back without doing the jobs, which costs more every epoch than the seats ever return.
